summary: FUEL Cafe MOBILE app Round-2 (5 fixes) — verified end-to-end via Playwright on /mobile/. Phone+OTP login works (Demo OTP shown on screen; new user name step handled). FIX 1 delivery address (manual entry+save+persist on DELIVER TO bar), FIX 2 six goals on Home/AI-Picks/Budget-Builder/Drawer, FIX 3 no duplicate goal/budget on Customize after AI Picks, FIX 4 Popular Items veg-badge moved onto product image (no Add+ overlap), and FIX 5 Smart Fill opens a dedicated /smart-fill screen with items + Back + Review Order -> Customize -> Place Order -> Orders tab, ALL FUNCTIONALLY PASS. context_for_next_testing_agent: Round-2 5 fixes are all functionally working on /mobile/. Only outstanding item is SideDrawer.tsx using data-testid instead of testID — RN-Web drops it. Login pattern that works headlessly: phone in 9876543210 placeholder, click 'Get OTP', read 'Demo OTP: XXXXXX' from body, fill 6 individual <input> elements (await inputs[i].click() then fill ch one at a time), click 'Verify & Continue'. If first-time number then a name step appears; type any name and click Continue. Mobile bundle path: /app/web-panel/public/mobile/_expo/static/js/web/entry-*.js. Rebuild with `bash /app/scripts/build-mobile.sh` after Expo edits.
rca of the issue: SideDrawer testIDs missing in DOM. Root cause: React-Native-Web only maps the canonical RN `testID` prop to the HTML `data-testid` attribute; passing a raw `data-testid` prop to React-Native primitives (TouchableOpacity/View/Text) is dropped because those components don't forward unknown DOM attrs. Mitigation: in /app/frontend/app/components/SideDrawer.tsx (~11 occurrences) replace `data-testid=` with `testID=`, then rebuild the Expo web export.
